definition: No passport needed; national ID suffices, with the right to live and work (e.g. within the EU)
Visa-free but needs an online authorisation first (UK ETA, Canada eTA, US ESTA)
Visa issued at the port of entry
Simplified e-visa applied for online before departure, usually decided within days without a full documentary assessment
Full visa: embassy, consulate or visa centre, or a full online application assessed with documents (e.g. UK, Canada, Australia visitor visas)
Entry banned, visa issuance suspended, no diplomatic relations, or a visa is practically unobtainable
The issuing country itself; counted at full weight
